Contract Generator.contract:
Contract CoCoMESystem::receiveOrderedProduct(orderID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderID)
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let existsOrderProduct: Boolean = obs.oclIsUndefined() = false in
		obs.OrderStatus = RECEIVED and
		obs.ContainedEntries->forAll(oe|oe.Item.StockNumber = oe.Item.StockNumber+oe.Quantity) and
		result = existsOrderProduct
}
